hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, os
f = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT_FILE_PATH', '')
if not f or not f.endswith(('.tsx','.ts')):
    sys.exit(0)
data = open(f,'rb').read()
bad = [i for i,b in enumerate(data) if b > 127]
if bad:
    print(f'WARNING: non-ASCII bytes in {f} at offsets {bad[:5]} -- SWC will break')
    sys.exit(2)
nulls = [i for i,b in enumerate(data) if b == 0]
if nulls:
    print(f'WARNING: null bytes in {f} -- file corrupted')
    sys.exit(2)
lines = len(data.splitlines())
if lines < 3:
    print(f'WARNING: {f} has only {lines} lines -- possible truncation')
    sys.exit(2)
print(f'OK: {f} ({lines} lines, no bad bytes)')
"
